texts: One HTML tag puts a live 3D avatar on any page, already idling when it appears

A live 3D avatar on any web page takes one script line and one <agent-3d> tag pointed at a body. The element stays hidden until the idle has rendered, so the avatar appears standing naturally, on Mixamo, VRM and other rigs alike. The write-up walks through each step between the tag and that frame, and what reduced motion does to it.

issues.problem: In the cover frame all three avatars have their heads tilted sharply upward and arms hanging in an unnatural neutral stance, which reads as a rest or bind pose rather than a relaxed idle. That undercuts the post's central statement that the avatar 'appears standing naturally' and the article's claim that all three bodies are running the same idle clip. A top-tier reader (or a screen-reader user trusting the alt text) sees a contradiction between the image and the copy.
issues.fix: Recapture public/x-media/embed-article/cover.png after the idle clip has played for several frames, so each avatar is clearly in a natural idle stance (head level, shoulders relaxed). If the retargeted idle genuinely leaves the heads tilted back on these rigs, drop the cover claim from the article and alt text instead of shipping an image that contradicts the post.

issues.problem: A reader new to three.ws may not parse 'a body' as a 3D model file on first read; the article clarifies but the X summary line itself carries the jargon.
issues.fix: Change to 'pointed at a GLB body file' or 'pointed at a 3D body (a GLB file)'.

posts: A live 3D avatar on any web page takes one script line and one <agent-3d> tag pointed at a GLB body file. The element keeps its canvas hidden until the idle has rendered, so the avatar appears standing naturally instead of in a bind pose, on Mixamo, VRM and other rigs alike. The write-up walks through each step between the tag and that frame, and what reduced motion does to it.
altText: Three 3D avatars rendered live by agent-3d elements, standing side by side on a dark background in a natural idle stance: a woman in a purple top and leggings, a character in a cropped top, yellow trousers and round pink glasses, and a man in a white T-shirt, light jeans and green trainers

editor.summary: Every claim in the post and article is verified against live pages and source files, and the copy obeys the voice contract. The one substantive problem is visual: the cover frame shows the three avatars with heads tilted back in what looks like a rest pose, contradicting the idle claim, so recapture before publish.
